description: Composite figure of three CALPHAD-calculated vertical sections (isopleths) computed with FactSage 8.2 for the C-Si-Mn-P-S-N-O-Al-Ti-Fe system, plotted as phase fields versus carbon content. Each panel plots temperature T(K) on the y-axis (gridlines 573, 773, 973, 1173, 1373, 1573, 1773, 1973, 2173) against C content (wt%) on the x-axis (0-1.4 in 0.2 steps) and carries the FactSage logo at top right; panels (a) and (c) display the header "C-Si-Mn-P-S-N-O-Al-Ti-Fe", which is cropped out of (b). (a) is sample 1 #, (b) 2 #, (c) 3 #. A green vertical line marks the alloy composition at C ≈ 0.4 wt% in all three panels; on it a red dot marks the liquidus temperature and a grey dot the solidus temperature, with the words "Liquidus" and "Solidus" arrowed to those dots only in (a). Phase fields are numbered: (a) shows regions 1-6; (b) shows 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9; (c) shows 1, 2, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 — the region count grows with Al content. The liquidus dot lies between the 1573 and 1773 K gridlines in (a) but essentially on the 1773 K gridline in (c), while the solidus dot sits close to 1573 K in every panel. No numeric temperatures are printed on the markers.

observations.observation: Each of the three panels is a FactSage-calculated vertical section with T(K) from 573 to 2173 on the y-axis and C content (wt%) from 0 to 1.4 on the x-axis.
A green vertical line at C ≈ 0.4 wt% is drawn in all three panels and marks the composition of interest.
On the green line, a red dot marks the liquidus and a grey dot marks the solidus; in panel (a) the words 'Liquidus' and 'Solidus' are attached to these dots by arrows.
In (a) and (b) the red liquidus dot lies between the 1573 and 1773 K gridlines, whereas in (c) it lies essentially on the 1773 K gridline, i.e. the plotted liquidus point is highest for 3 #.
The grey solidus dot lies close to the 1573 K gridline in every panel (slightly above it in (a) and (b), essentially on it in (c)).
The numbered phase fields increase in number with sample: (a) contains regions 1-6, (b) contains 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, and (c) contains 1, 2, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11.
The header text 'C-Si-Mn-P-S-N-O-Al-Ti-Fe' and the FactSage logo are visible in panels (a) and (c); the header is cropped out of panel (b), which only shows the logo.
No numerical temperature values are printed next to the liquidus or solidus markers; temperatures can only be referred to the 200 K-spaced axis gridlines.

The caption identifies (a) as sample 1 #, (b) as 2 #, and (c) as 3 #, and states that the figure gives calculated solidification routes together with liquidus and solidus temperatures for the three samples.
The citing text states the calculations were performed with the phase diagram module of FactSage 8.2 for the Fe-C-Si-Mn-P-S-S-Al-O-N-Ti system.
The citing text reports the solidification route of sample 1 # as L → L + FCC → FCC.
The citing text reports that the solidification routes of 2 # and 3 # pass through BCC: L → L + BCC → L + BCC + FCC → L + FCC → FCC for 2 #, and a route ending in BCC + FCC → FCC for 3 #.
The citing text states that increasing Al content makes the solidification route of 2 # and 3 # pass through the BCC phase and decreases the area where the FCC phase exists.
The citing text states that Table 3 gives the phase composition corresponding to the numbers labelled in Figure 6; those phase identities are therefore not readable from this figure alone.

subfigures.description: Calculated phase-field map for sample 1 #: T(K) 573-2173 vs C content (wt%) 0-1.4; green vertical line at C ≈ 0.4 wt% carrying a red liquidus dot (between the 1573 and 1773 K gridlines) and a grey solidus dot (just above 1573 K), with arrowed labels 'Liquidus' and 'Solidus'. Numbered fields 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

Calculated phase-field map for sample 2 #: same axes; green vertical line at C ≈ 0.4 wt% with red liquidus dot (slightly below the 1773 K gridline) and grey solidus dot near 1573 K; an arrow points from label 9 towards the solidus dot. Numbered fields 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. Header formula is not visible in this panel.

Calculated phase-field map for sample 3 #: same axes with header 'C-Si-Mn-P-S-N-O-Al-Ti-Fe'; green vertical line at C ≈ 0.4 wt% with red liquidus dot essentially on the 1773 K gridline and grey solidus dot close to the 1573 K gridline. Numbered fields 1, 2, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 — more fields than (a) or (b).

unreadable_items: Exact liquidus and solidus temperatures of the red/grey markers are not printed; only the 200 K-spaced gridlines allow a range to be stated
The phase identity of the numbered regions (1-11) is not given in this figure; it is deferred to Table 3
Panel (b): the 'C-Si-Mn-P-S-N-O-Al-Ti-Fe' header present in (a) and (c) is cropped and not visible
